legend: You have n$$$n$$$ sticks of the given lengths.

Your task is to choose exactly four of them in such a way that they can form a rectangle. No sticks can be cut to pieces, each side of the rectangle must be formed by a single stick. No stick can be chosen multiple times. It is guaranteed that it is always possible to choose such sticks.
Let S$$$S$$$ be the area of the rectangle and P$$$P$$$ be the perimeter of the rectangle.
The chosen rectangle should have the value P2S$$$\frac{P^2}{S}$$$ minimal possible. The value is taken without any rounding.
If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
Each testcase contains several lists of sticks, for each of them you are required to solve the problem separately.
input: The first line contains a single integer T$$$T$$$ (T≥1$$$T \ge 1$$$) — the number of lists of sticks in the testcase.

Then 2T$$$2T$$$ lines follow — lines (2i−1)$$$(2i - 1)$$$ and 2i$$$2i$$$ of them describe the i$$$i$$$-th list. The first line of the pair contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (4≤n≤106$$$4 \le n \le 10^6$$$) — the number of sticks in the i$$$i$$$-th list. The second line of the pair contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ (1≤aj≤104$$$1 \le a_j \le 10^4$$$) — lengths of the sticks in the i$$$i$$$-th list.
It is guaranteed that for each list there exists a way to choose four sticks so that they form a rectangle.
The total number of sticks in all T$$$T$$$ lists doesn't exceed 106$$$10^6$$$ in each testcase.
output: Print T$$$T$$$ lines. The i$$$i$$$-th line should contain the answer to the i$$$i$$$-th list of the input. That is the lengths of the four sticks you choose from the i$$$i$$$-th list, so that they form a rectangle and the value P2S$$$\frac{P^2}{S}$$$ of this rectangle is minimal possible. You can print these four lengths in arbitrary order.
If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
note: There is only one way to choose four sticks in the first list, they form a rectangle with sides 2$$$2$$$ and 7$$$7$$$, its area is 2⋅7=14$$$2 \cdot 7 = 14$$$, perimeter is 2(2+7)=18$$$2(2 + 7) = 18$$$. 18214≈23.143$$$\frac{18^2}{14} \approx 23.143$$$.

The second list contains subsets of four sticks that can form rectangles with sides (1,2)$$$(1, 2)$$$, (2,8)$$$(2, 8)$$$ and (1,8)$$$(1, 8)$$$. Their values are 622=18$$$\frac{6^2}{2} = 18$$$, 20216=25$$$\frac{20^2}{16} = 25$$$ and 1828=40.5$$$\frac{18^2}{8} = 40.5$$$, respectively. The minimal one of them is the rectangle (1,2)$$$(1, 2)$$$.
You can choose any four of the 5$$$5$$$ given sticks from the third list, they will form a square with side 5$$$5$$$, which is still a rectangle with sides (5,5)$$$(5, 5)$$$.

legend.ai: 你有 n$$$n$$$ 根给定长度的木棍。
你的任务是恰好选择其中四根木棍，使它们能够组成一个矩形。不能将木棍切成若干段，矩形的每条边都必须由一根木棍构成。同一根木棍不能被重复选择。保证总能选择出满足条件的木棍。
令 S$$$S$$$ 表示矩形的面积，P$$$P$$$ 表示矩形的周长。
选出的矩形应使 P2S$$$\frac{P^2}{S}$$$ 的值尽可能小。该值不进行任何舍入。
如果有多个答案，输出其中任意一个即可。
每个测试用例包含若干个木棍列表，对于每个列表，都需要单独解决该问题。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$(T≥1$$$T \ge 1$$$)——测试用例中木棍列表的数量。

接下来有 2T$$$2T$$$ 行——其中第 (2i−1)$$$(2i - 1)$$$ 行和第 2i$$$2i$$$ 行描述第 i$$$i$$$ 个列表。每对中的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(4≤n≤10^6$$$4 \le n \le 10^6$$$)——第 i$$$i$$$ 个列表中的木棍数量。每对中的第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$(1≤aj≤10^4$$$1 \le a_j \le 10^4$$$)——第 i$$$i$$$ 个列表中木棍的长度。
保证对于每个列表，都存在一种选取四根木棍的方法，使它们组成一个矩形。
在每个测试用例中，所有 T$$$T$$$ 个列表中的木棍总数不超过 10^6$$$10^6$$$。

output.ai: 输出 T$$$T$$$ 行。第 i$$$i$$$ 行应包含输入中第 i$$$i$$$ 个列表对应的答案，即从第 i$$$i$$$ 个列表中选出的四根木棍的长度，使它们组成一个矩形，且该矩形的 P^2/S$$$\frac{P^2}{S}$$$ 值尽可能小。你可以按任意顺序输出这四个长度。
如果有多个答案，输出任意一个。

note.ai: 你可以从第三个列表给出的 5$$$5$$$ 根木棍中任意选择四根，它们将组成一个边长为 5$$$5$$$ 的正方形，而正方形仍然是边长为 (5,5)$$$(5, 5)$$$ 的矩形。
